subject: ⚠️ Graduation Audit — Outstanding Requirements on $program_name
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your latest graduation audit shows that you are NOT yet on track to graduate from $program_name. The gaps are listed below so you can address them with your academic advisor.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
AUDIT SUMMARY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Student ID:           $student_id
Programme:            $program_name
Audit Run On:         $audit_date

Credits Earned:       $credits_earned / $credits_required   ($credits_status)
Current GPA:          $current_gpa  (required: $gpa_required)   ($gpa_status)
Requirements Met:     $completed_requirements / $total_requirements   ($requirements_status)
Final Verdict:        NOT YET ELIGIBLE

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

OUTSTANDING ITEMS

$gap_list

RECOMMENDED NEXT STEPS

  1. Book a meeting with your academic advisor within the next two weeks.
  2. Use the What-If planner in the Student Portal to model module choices that close the gap.
  3. If a result on the audit looks wrong, ask the Registry to re-check transcripts.
  4. Re-run the audit after you register for additional modules so you can confirm the gap is closing.

We are here to help — this notice is intended as an early warning, not a final ruling.

Kind regards,
Office of the Registrar
